summary.name: LTX Studio
summary.one_liner: LTX Studio is a web-based generative AI platform for creating, editing, and producing videos from text, image, audio, or video inputs, powered by the LTX model.
use_cases: Turning a script into scenes and storyboards
Generating short videos from text prompts or reference images
Creating ads and marketing video assets
Keeping characters and locations consistent across scenes
Expanding or repurposing existing video with AI
summary.what_it_does: The platform generates video from text prompts, image references, audio, or a mix, in a dedicated workspace. It offers camera movement controls, keyframes, and visual references to direct individual shots. Preset visual styles (cinematic, sketch, branded) are available to explore looks while keeping consistency. AI Characters, Objects, and Locations can be reused across a project to maintain continuity. Tools span pre-production (script upload, storyboards) through post-production, and the page says it is web-based with no downloads needed.
notable: Text, image, audio, and video inputs for video generation
Camera, keyframe, and reference controls for shot direction
AI Characters, Objects, and Locations for cross-scene consistency
LTX-2 model is open source, though the LTX Platform itself is not
caveats: Not available on mobile or as a mobile app; desktop browser recommended
Free plan has basic features; premium tools, faster generations, and more computing time require a paid plan
Full pricing details are on a separate Pricing page and were not listed here
